digo_source: ICRAF Useful Trees ('Digo: Mudzwi'); Pakia 2005 Appendix III ('Mutsu', also listed under 'Mkoko')

teaser.en: Its leaves sweat salt you can see and taste, and the bao boards and mortars of the coast are often carved from its wood.
teaser.sw: Majani yake hutoa jasho la chumvi unaloweza kuliona na kulionja, na mbao za bao na vinu vya pwani mara nyingi huchongwa kwa mbao zake.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganalavya munyu unaoweza kuuona na kuuonja, na mabao na vinu vya pwani kpwa kawaida nkutsongbwa kula kpwa nyama za muhi uhu.

summary.en: *Mudzwi*, the grey mangrove, is the toughest of the mangroves, growing from the seaward fringe to the salty, dry landward edge. Its wood becomes furniture legs, mortars and pestles, bao boards, drums and beehives, and its leaves feed fish and goats.
summary.sw: *Mudzwi* ni mchu, mkoko mgumu kuliko mikoko yote, unaostawi kuanzia ukingo wa upande wa bahari hadi ukingo mkavu wenye chumvi wa upande wa nchi kavu. Mbao zake hutengenezwa miguu ya samani, vinu na michi, mbao za bao, ngoma na mizinga ya nyuki, na majani yake hulisha samaki na mbuzi.
summary.dg: *Mudzwi* ni mkoko wenye nguvu kuriko mikoko yosi, unaomera kula uphande wa bahari hadi kanda ya bara yenye munyu na kavu. Nyama za muhi nkuhendwa magulu ga vitanda na vihi, vinu na mitsi, mabao, ngoma na mizinga ya nyuchi, na makodzage ni chakurya cha ng'onda na mbuzi.

about.en:
*Mudzwi* is a grey-barked tree, from a low shrub on harsh ground to a full-sized tree where conditions suit it. The leaves are green above and silvery-grey beneath, and they excrete salt: on a dry day you can often see small crystals on the leaf surface.

Around the tree, the mud is carpeted with thousands of pencil-like breathing roots, called pneumatophores, which stick straight up from cable roots running beneath the surface. Its small yellow-orange flowers are scented and attract bees.
about.sw:
*Mudzwi* ni mti wenye gamba la kijivu, kuanzia kichaka kifupi kwenye ardhi ngumu hadi mti kamili mahali ambapo hali inaufaa. Majani ni ya kijani upande wa juu na kijivu cha fedha upande wa chini, na hutoa chumvi: siku ya ukavu mara nyingi unaweza kuona fuwele ndogo juu ya jani.

Kuzunguka mti, matope yamefunikwa na maelfu ya mizizi ya kupumulia inayofanana na penseli, inayoitwa pneumatofori, inayochomoza wima kutoka mizizi kama kamba inayotambaa chini ya uso wa matope. Maua yake madogo ya rangi ya manjano-machungwa yana harufu nzuri na huvutia nyuki.
about.dg:
*Mudzwi* ni muhi wenye gopha ra rangi ya ivu, kula chitsaka chifupi kpwa tsi ngumu hadi muhi mkulu kamili phatu phanaphoufwaha. Makodza ni ga chijani dzulu na ga rangi ya feza photsi, na ganalavya munyu: siku isiyo na mvula kpwa kawaida unaweza kuona tembe ndide za munyu dzulu ya kodza.

Kanda-kanda ya muhi, matope gakafunikpwa ni maelufu ga mizi dza kalamu ya kuphahira pumuzi, inayoihwa *pneumatophores*, inayoima chocho kula kpwa mizi mire inayotsupa tsini ya matope. Maruwage madide ga rangi ya mandano na chungbwa gana harufu nono na ganamweha nyuchi.

where.en: No mangrove grows in so wide a range of places. *Mudzwi* is found both on the seaward fringe and on the dry landward edge of the mangroves, where it tolerates very high salinity that other species cannot. Along Gazi Bay, Funzi and Vanga, the fields of pencil roots around it are easiest to see at low tide.
where.sw: Hakuna mkoko unaostawi katika mazingira mengi tofauti kama huu. *Mudzwi* hupatikana kwenye ukingo wa upande wa bahari na pia kwenye ukingo mkavu wa upande wa nchi kavu wa mikoko, ambako huvumilia kiwango cha juu sana cha chumvi ambacho spishi nyingine haziwezi. Kando ya Ghuba ya Gazi, Funzi na Vanga, maeneo ya mizizi kama penseli yanayouzunguka huonekana kwa urahisi zaidi maji yanapokupwa.
where.dg: Takuna mkoko unaomera kpwa phatu tafwauti dza mudzwi. *Mudzwi* unaphahikana uphande wa bahari na kanda ya bara iriyo kavu ya mikoko, ambapho unavumirira munyu mnji sana ambao aina zanjina taziweza kuuvumirira. Kanda-kanda ya Gazi, Funzi na Vanga, minda ya mizi dza kalamu iriyouzunguluka ni rahisi zaidi kuiona wakati wa madzi ga kala.

uses.en:
The wood is turned into bed, chair and table legs, fencing posts, mortars and pestles, boat ribs, bao boards for the board game, drums and beehives. It is also burned as charcoal and firewood.

The leaves and roots are used in medicine. The leaves are food for fish in the mangrove and fodder for goats and camels.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake huchongwa kuwa miguu ya vitanda, viti na meza, nguzo za ua, vinu na michi, mbavu za mashua, mbao za mchezo wa bao, ngoma na mizinga ya nyuki. Pia huchomwa kuwa makaa na kuni.

Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa. Majani ni chakula cha samaki ndani ya mikoko na lishe ya mbuzi na ngamia.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi nkuhendwa magulu ga vitanda, vihi na meza, nguzo za uchigo, vinu na mitsi, mbavu za ngarawa, mabao ga mchezo wa bao, ngoma na mizinga ya nyuchi. Piya nkuochwa kuhenda makala na kuni.

Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa. Makodza ni chakurya cha ng'onda kahi ya mikoko na chakurya cha mbuzi na ngamia.

culture.en: The Digo count *mutsu* among the *mikoko*, the mangroves, along with *mdzago* and *mkoko*.
culture.sw: Wadigo huhesabu *mutsu* miongoni mwa *mikoko*, pamoja na *mdzago* na *mkoko*.
culture.dg: Adigo anaolanga *mutsu* kahi ya *mikoko*, phamwenga na *mdzago* na *mkoko*.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mudzwi*; Pakia records *mutsu*, also listed under *mkoko*. The two names need checking with speakers. In Swahili it is *mchu* or *mtsu*. Giriama has *mtswi* and *mudzu*, and in Bajun it is *mutu*. In English it is the grey or white mangrove, and botanists call it *Avicennia marina*.
names.sw: Kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mudzwi*; Pakia anarekodi *mutsu*, ambalo pia limeorodheshwa chini ya *mkoko*. Majina haya mawili yanahitaji kuthibitishwa na wazungumzaji. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mchu* au *mtsu*. Kigiriama kina *mtswi* na *mudzu*, na kwa Kibajuni ni *mutu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *grey mangrove* au *white mangrove*, na wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Avicennia marina*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha dzina ra Chidigo *mudzwi*; Pakia anaandika *mutsu*, na piya anauandika photsi ya *mkoko*. Madzina higa mairi ganahitaji kulolwa na atu anaogomba Chidigo. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mchu* au *mtsu*. Chigiryama china *mtswi* na *mudzu*, na kpwa Chibajuni ni *mutu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *grey mangrove* au *white mangrove*, na asayansi a mimea anauiha *Avicennia marina*.

conservation.en: Globally Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel; harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and communities at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring mangrove forest.
conservation.sw: Kimataifa uko katika kundi la Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya nguzo na nishati; uvunaji hutolewa leseni na Shirika la Huduma za Misitu Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinarejesha misitu ya mikoko.
conservation.dg: Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni; kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service, na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinauyiza matsaka ga mikoko.
